verdict.rationale: Ramp ships its own in-product AI agents (Ramp Intelligence), so letting users plug external MCP servers into it is a fair question. However, the pack only documents Ramp acting as an MCP server for outside assistants like Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor, plus a CLI. Nothing shows Ramp's agents consuming tools from user-supplied MCP servers, and the server-side evidence cannot be credited to this client-side story.
